text:
Maya P.: FYI: hardware SI wants to list Redwood in their cloud marketplace tile but their procurement requires two extra artifacts: HSM attestation (vendor-signed), and a supply-chain questionnaire (signed). They also want confirmation were covered by our ISO27001 cert.

Arjun K. (sec): HSM attestation is doable but depends on KMS provider SLA. We can provide a vendor attestation copy (redacted serials) + an internal note describing key separation. Lena, legal will need to approve the attestation language.

Lena J. (legal): Please surface the raw attestation and any redactions. We need to confirm there's no export-controlled tech copied. Also confirm whether the attestation contains customer IDs.

Marco R. (infra): If the attestation references HSM model numbers, thats OK. We must not include any production key identifiers. We can generate a redacted PDF and a short "what is attested" one-pager.

Maya P.: Partner also asked for a completed supply-chain questionnaire (they supplied their template). I propose we: 1) map their questions to our standard vendor responses, 2) call out third-party vendors, 3) sign and return. Can we get a signer from legal?

Lena J. (legal): I can sign once Sec and Infra verify accuracy. Send me the completed answers PDF and a compliance owner.

Arjun K. (sec): I'll fill security-related sections (key management, patching cadence, vuln scanning, pen-test cadence). Marco please add infra entries (procurement, firmware update policy).

Marco R. (infra): Will do. Also: for public marketplace artifacts we prefer presigned links with 14-day TTL for hardware partners who need more legal review. Is that acceptable?

Maya P.: Partner asked for 14 days specifically. OK to use 14 days for this listing only. We'll log TTL in the tracker.

build-bot: Reminder queued: "SC questionnaire draft due" on 2026-05-12 09:00.

Arjun K. (sec): A few redaction rules: remove serials, internal ticket IDs, and precise firmware versions that are under embargo. Replace with ranges or "managed by vendor" text. Replace any CVE mention with the public advisory link rather than raw exploit info.

Maya P.: Action items: Arjun fills sec sections by Tue EOD; Marco fills infra sections by Tue EOD; Lena to sign by Wed; Maya to send final artifacts to partner on Thu.

Marco R. (infra): Question: partner requests SOC3 (public) instead of SOC2 PDF. We have SOC2 Type II standard attestation; do we publish SOC3?

Lena J. (legal): We don't currently publish SOC3. We can provide SOC2 attestation and an executive summary that mirrors the public controls. Explain to partner that SOC3 is not produced but SOC2 attestation and ISO27001 cert are available.

Maya P.: I'll communicate that. Also partner wants to co-announce after listing goes live. Legal: any restrictions on joint announcement wording given the attestation exchange?

Lena J. (legal): Keep announcement high level: "integration and marketplace listing". No claims about security posture beyond "meets industry compliance". Any mention of specific certifications or test results must be pre-cleared.

Arjun K. (sec): For the supply-chain answers, we'll add a short appendix listing tested vendors and the monitoring cadence. Also propose we include an aggregated pen-test SLA statement: "internal pen-tests annually, external every 12-18 months".

Marco R. (infra): Upload path: s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/inbound/partner-hw/attestation.pdf and /inbound/partner-hw/supplychain-q.pdf. Outbound redacted bundle will go to /outbound/partner-hw/.

Maya P.: When outbound bundle is ready, we'll create presigned links with TTL=1209600 (14 days). Ben did a 7-day example earlier; Marco can run presign.

Marco R. (infra): Command I'll use: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/outbound/partner-hw/hw-compliance-bundle.zip --expires-in 1209600`

Lena J. (legal): Add a README.txt explaining redactions and a contact for escalation (legal@redwood.com). Also include a signed cover letter PDF.

Arjun K. (sec): Security signoff needed before presign. I'll review redactions and the final bundle.

Maya P.: Timeline check: draft answers Tue 17:00, legal sign Wed 12:00, presign Thu 09:00, partner notified Thu 10:00, joint announcement planning to start after listing goes live (TBD).

build-bot: Reminder set for @channel: "Sign supply-chain questionnaire" on 2026-05-13 12:00.

Marco R. (infra): Uploaded drafts to inbound path and left `redaction_plan.md`. Ready for Arjun review.

Arjun K. (sec): Reviewed; two inline redaction notes on firmware versioning. Marco updated. All good. Security signoff granted.

Lena J. (legal): Signed cover letter and questionnaire. Files in outbound.

Maya P.: Presigned links created and sent to partner (TTL 14 days). Partner acknowledged receipt and requested tentative announcement window next quarter.

Marco R. (infra): Recorded exchange in marketplace tracker & set outbound retention=60 days per hardware partner agreement.

Maya P.: Thanks all. I'll add a short template to partnerships playbook for future HSM/supply-chain requests. Thread closing unless anyone has follow-ups.

Arjun K. (sec): +1. Good template.

Lena J. (legal): Thanks team.

Maya P.: :white_check_mark:
